$comment: THE REGIONS HUMANS HAVE NAMES FOR. This file is vocabulary, not truth: it declares what each name ASSERTS about a projection, and the catalogue the realizer reads is GENERATED by running those assertions against the live enumeration. Doctrine line 211: requesting a form is an assertion of its preconditions. A name whose region selects no retained program is reported as an unsatisfied assertion and never becomes an entry. A region may state any subset of coordinate, dimension and measure; an omitted field constrains nothing.
